title: Sting vs. Vader: speed against overwhelming power
summary: Vader’s size and aggression give Sting a different kind of championship rival. Their title exchanges and international rematches keep WCW’s hero fighting from underneath.

chapters.title: Vader takes the world title
chapters.result: Vader defeats Sting for the WCW championship.
chapters.context: The monster challenger turns his physical dominance into control of the promotion’s top prize.

chapters.title: Sting wins in London
chapters.result: Sting defeats Vader to regain the world championship.
chapters.context: The rivalry reaches an international payoff as Sting overcomes the champion in England.

chapters.title: Vader takes the belt back in Dublin
chapters.result: Vader defeats Sting to regain the championship.
chapters.context: The short reign ends on the same tour, restoring Vader as WCW’s central threat.
